description: Import and Export Control Department - Regulations made to include the item, Maize (com) Starch in Schedule I of the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1813/14 of 05.06.2013
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Finance under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, specifically amending import control regulations. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for import/export matters, which is a Type 5 classification. While a minister is named, the primary content is regulatory/legal in nature, not about government personnel or structure.
